scope: 0.2.0 Mac Apple Silicon simulator preview with published Culsma 1.0.10
invariants: Use the published Culsma 1.0.10 wheel unchanged, verified against the upstream release SHA-256
Unpublished simulator wheels have PEP 440 local version labels derived from exact source commits
Snapshot builds use immutable committed sources and change distribution version metadata only
OS tests own all required test inputs; installed plugins need no sibling source checkout
Clean runs import from non-editable wheels, with no PYTHONPATH or source-path injection
The wheel, sdist, entry points, and Python 3.11/3.12 profiles must be verified separately
Validation runs locally, with no GitHub Actions; the public release provides anonymous download URLs and fixed hashes

release.scope: Self-contained macOS arm64 simulator app with isolated MCP bridge; Python archives and fixed dependency wheels
release.api_access: GitHub Release assets; dedicated release credential for publication
release.anonymous_access: Public release URLs; verify downloads against the recorded hashes
